Nice dry snow tonight which set up nicely as the night went on. Inner trails are all groomed and track set, The Aqueduct from the Nordic Bowl to the Dam Wall has one patchy section, otherwise it is looking nice. Aqueduct from Wombats to High Plains Road is looking good, there is just one small section which is very thin. Prett Valley Road to the Cattle Grid is closed, I started cutting the trail back in tonight, but it has not been groomed yet, it was also very windy tonight so I expect it will have drifted again by morning anyway. McKay Loop has been groomed but not track set, I should be able to get up there Sunday night and finish it and PVR off. Pretty Valley Road from Aitkens down has been groomed but not track set, I had planned to do it on my way back to the workshop at the end of shift, but I was running dangerously low on fuel and had to cut down Aitkens instead. High Plains Road is a little patchy in a couple spots from the Nordic Bowl to the Dam Wall, but it has at least a full cat wide trail the length of it. The first 100 mtrs from windy corner are snowless.
